comment: M12 license gate allow-list (build spec §14.18 gate 3). Fail-closed: any third-party license expression that does not evaluate against this list refuses — including UNKNOWN and UNLICENSED. First-party @sentinel/* workspace packages are exempt (they are the product, not the supply chain). An addition to this list is a contract change: it needs a DECISIONS record naming why the license is safe for a closed-ecosystem product.
